001: Are you looking for a part-time job lately?
Yeah, I want to find a weekend job.
So, what do you want to do?
I want to try working at a coffee shop.
That place seems to be hiring right now.
Really? Then I'll go ask tomorrow.
002: Is your part-time job far from school?
Not really, it's only three stops by subway.
That's pretty convenient. How's the pay?
Twenty-five yuan an hour, and they also provide meals.
Sounds good. How long have you been working there?
Just two weeks, I'm still getting used to it.
003: Why did you stop working at the library?
The shifts there were too few, I couldn't make any money.
So, is your current job busy?
There are tons of customers on weekends, sometimes it's really tiring.
Do you think you can stick with it?
I should be able to. My coworkers all take good care of me.
004: What do you do for your part-time job?
I help organize the shelves at a bookstore.
The work environment must be pretty quiet, right?
Yeah, and I can even sneak in some time to read new books.
That's great. I want to find a job like that too.
They're still hiring recently. Do you want to give it a try?
005: Do you have to go to work tonight?
Not today, I swapped my shift off.
Perfect then, let's go grab dinner together?
Sure, but I need to come back early to study.
No problem, we'll just have a quick meal.
Okay, see you downstairs in a bit.
006: How's the boss at your part-time job?
He's a nice person, but his requirements are pretty strict.
Like, we can't look at our phones during work, and we have to stand the whole time.
That does sound tough. Can you handle it?
I'm slowly getting used to it. Anyway, it's good training for me.
007: How many days a week do you work?
Two days during the week, plus one day on the weekend.
Do you have enough time to study?
It's a bit tight, so I review my work at night.
You should take care of yourself too, don't overdo it.
Don't worry, I'll manage my time well.
008: How did that interview you mentioned go?
I passed. I start working next Monday.
Congratulations! What exactly will you be doing?
Working as a server at a restaurant, mainly handling orders.
Then you'll need to memorize the menu. That really tests your memory.
Yeah, I've been studying it these past couple of days.
009: What do you plan to do with the money you earn from your part-time job?
I want to save it up first and buy a new computer.
That'll take a few months of saving, right?
Yeah, so I don't dare spend money carelessly right now.
You're really disciplined. I can never save up.
I had to make a huge decision to hold back too.
010: Why did you suddenly quit that job?
Because it conflicted with my class schedule.
Yeah, there's nothing you can do about that. Have you found a new job?
Yes, at a convenience store nearby.
Pretty flexible. You can choose your own time slots.
